verdict.rationale: Productboard exposes a Webhooks API for real-time event notifications and an MCP server that lets AI agents act on data, which are building blocks for automation, but there is no evidence of a native scheduling/automation-rules engine or truly autonomous background agent execution within Productboard itself — webhooks require external automation logic to act on them. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in scheduled/triggered automation or workflow engine, evidence of agents running unattended on a recurring basis rather than only on user-initiated prompts.
